sources.title: SAM 2 - ZeroModels
sources.snippet: SAM2 keeps SAM 's promptable formulation and replaces the plain ViT with a Hiera backbone: a hierarchical encoder that produces multi-scale features, feeding an FPN neck before the mask decoder. The result is both faster and sharper at object boundaries than the original.
